method.name: TextureUnit
method.description: Default texture unit to be used, default is Graphic3d_TextureUnit_BaseColor.

method.name: IsModulate
method.description: Returns TRUE if the texture is modulate. Default value is FALSE.

method.name: IsRepeat
method.description: Returns TRUE if the texture repeat is enabled. Default value is FALSE.

method.name: SetRepeat
method.description: ! @param theToRepeat turn texture repeat mode ON or OFF (clamping).

method.name: Filter
method.description: Returns texture interpolation filter. Default value is Graphic3d_TOTF_NEAREST.

method.name: AnisoFilter
method.description: Returns level of anisontropy texture filter. Default value is Graphic3d_LOTA_OFF.

method.name: SetAnisoFilter
method.description: ! @param theLevel level of anisontropy texture filter.

method.name: Rotation
method.description: Return rotation angle in degrees; 0 by default. Complete transformation matrix: Rotation -> Translation -> Scale.

method.name: GenMode
method.description: Returns texture coordinates generation mode. Default value is Graphic3d_TOTM_MANUAL.

method.name: BaseLevel
method.description: Returns base texture mipmap level; 0 by default.

method.name: MaxLevel
method.description: Return maximum texture mipmap array level; 1000 by default. Real rendering limit will take into account mipmap generation flags and presence of mipmaps in loaded image.

method.name: SetLevelsRange
method.description: Setups texture mipmap array levels range. The lowest value will be the base level. The remaining one will be the maximum level.

method.name: SamplerRevision
method.description: Return modification counter of parameters related to sampler state.
